title: SPRI shoulders superset
summary: Short clip of a resistance band (SPRI) shoulder superset, set to music. Per the description, these are quick, low-impact band movements (front raises and overhead presses) to pump all three heads of the deltoid.

claims.claim: A superset of resistance band (SPRI) front raises and band overhead presses is a quick, low-impact way to pump all three heads of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Resistance band overhead press
exercises.why: low-impact shoulder pump, superset with raises
